target_audience: UG and PG Students (Hostelers & Day Scholars)

faqs.question: What is the evening gate closing time for hostelers, and how do I apply for outing permission?
student_query_variations: what time does hostel gate close
gate timings for boys and girls hostel
how to get outing pass in sathyabama
faqs.official_answer: General in-time for hostel students is 6:30 PM. Outing passes must be applied 24 hours in advance via the student portal with parent/warden digital confirmation. Emergency permissions require direct approval from the Chief Warden's office.
faqs.verified_by: Hostel Office & Chief Warden Circular Ref: SIS-HOSTEL/2025-01

faqs.question: Are food deliveries like Swiggy and Zomato allowed inside the campus/hostel?
student_query_variations: can i order swiggy inside hostel
is outside food allowed in sathyabama
faqs.official_answer: Delivery riders are strictly restricted to Main Gate 1 and Gate 3. Students must collect deliveries directly from the gate security cabin before 8:30 PM. Deliveries directly to hostel room blocks are strictly prohibited.

faqs.question: How do I register for arrear exams and what is the fee per subject?
student_query_variations: how to apply for arrear exam
how to apply for paper revaluation
faqs.official_answer: Arrear registration opens 3 weeks before end-semester examinations via the COE portal. The standard fee is ₹750 per theory paper and ₹1,000 for practicals (subject to annual revision). Revaluation applications must be submitted within 7 days of result declaration.

faqs.question: What is the minimum CGPA and standing arrear criteria for Tier-1 placement drives?
student_query_variations: can i sit for placements with arrears
faqs.official_answer: For core and Dream/Super-Dream Tier-1 recruitment (CTC > 8 LPA), students must maintain a minimum of 7.5 CGPA with zero standing (active) arrears. Tier-2 and mass drives generally allow students with up to 1 history arrear provided all subjects are cleared before the 7th semester.
faqs.verified_by: Centre for Career Guidance and Development (CDC)

faqs.question: How can I join the Microsoft Club at Sathyabama and register for technical hackathons?
student_query_variations: how to join microsoft club sathyabama
faqs.official_answer: Microsoft Club conducts annual recruitments in August-September across Technical (AI/ML, Web/App, Cloud), Creative, and Event Management tracks. Official announcements and hackathon registrations are published on the club's portal and official Instagram (@microsoftclubsist). On-Duty (OD) attendance is provided for approved participants.
faqs.verified_by: Microsoft Club Faculty Coordinator & Student Leads
